description_en: Checks the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service, which is required to add a region to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 检查指定的地域加入专线网关所需的云数据传输服务
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter check-add-region-to-express-connect-router --ecr-id ecr-fu8rszhgv7623c0000 --fresh-region-id cn-hangzhou --dry-run false --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region that you want to add to ECR
parameters.help_zh: 指定专线网关功能是否开通云数据传输服务的地域
parameters.name: fresh_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs a dry run to check the request. No service resources are modified.

- false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

- false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token on your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token
